class.name: CapsuleShape3D
class.brief_description: A 3D capsule shape used for physics collision.
class.description: A 3D capsule shape, intended for use in physics. Usually used to provide a shape for a [CollisionShape3D]. [b]Performance:[/b] [CapsuleShape3D] is fast to check collisions against. It is faster than [CylinderShape3D], but slower than [SphereShape3D] and [BoxShape3D].

members.member: Radius of the bottom hemisphere. If different from [member top_radius], the capsule becomes tapered. If greater than [member top_radius] + [member mid_height], the capsule becomes a sphere.

The capsule's full height, including the hemispheres. [b]Note:[/b] The [member height] of a capsule must be at least twice its [member radius]. Otherwise, the capsule becomes a sphere. If the [member height] is less than twice the [member radius], the properties adjust to a valid value.

The capsule's height, excluding the hemispheres. This is the height of the central cylindrical part in the middle of the capsule, and is the distance between the centers of the two hemispheres. This is a wrapper for [member height].
Radius of the hemispheres of the capsule shape.
Radius of the top hemisphere. If different from [member bottom_radius], the capsule becomes tapered. If greater than [member bottom_radius] + [member mid_height], the capsule becomes a sphere.
